turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|PROVIDE| C{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|ASSAY| R[Read received document]

    C -->|No| C1[Ask for mode]
    C1 --> C
    C -->|Yes| D[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    D --> E{HUMAN mode?}
    E -->|Yes| F[Run the speak test]
    E -->|No| G[Continue]
    F --> G
    G --> H{Floor passes?}

    H -->|No| I{Three or fewer gaps?}
    I -->|Yes| I1[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    I -->|No| I2[Ask three largest gaps]
    I2 --> I3[Assume the remaining gaps]
    I1 --> J[Wait for answer]
    I3 --> J
    J --> D

    H -->|Yes| K[Compress the prompt]
    K --> L{Cut removed specification?}
    L -->|Yes| M[Revert the destructive cut]
    M --> K
    L -->|No| N{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    N -->|No| O{Floor still passes?}
    O -->|No| P[Return the last passing version]
    O -->|Yes| K
    N -->|Yes| Q[Contract is minimal]
    P --> Q
    Q --> S[Output the PROVIDE contract]
    S --> T{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    T -->|Keep negotiating| K
    T -->|Freeze, execute, or run it from the named human signer| U{Execution tools available?}
    U -->|No| V[Gate stays closed]
    U -->|Yes| W[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    W --> X{Result}
    X -->|Success| Y[Done]
    X -->|Floor item fails| Z[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    Z --> K

    R --> R1[Compress to floor residue]
    R1 --> R2[Name evaporated content and function]
    R2 --> R3[Locate the operative sentence]
    R3 --> R4[Report ratio and erosion direction]
    R4 --> R5[Flag a missing rough edge]
    R5 --> R6[Output the ASSAY finding]
    R6 --> R7[This is a finding, not a draft.]
```
